reason: I've never seen their work and ₱1,800 is more than I usually pay at the mall, where I get my nails done while I'm already shopping anyway. A stranger coming to my house with a kit isn't something I'd book just from a Facebook post.
objection: I have no idea if the nail artist is actually good. No portfolio I've seen, no reviews from people I know, and if it's for a wedding I can't risk bad nails in the photos.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real portfolio of their bridal sets on their Facebook page plus reviews or tags from actual brides, ideally someone I know who used them for their wedding.
